# Copilot instructions

- Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before starting any tracker ticket.
- Follow the tracker state machine in [state-machine.json](factory/state-machine.json). Do not skip states.
- Write tests with each change. A change without tests fails review.
- Never commit secrets, credentials, or `.env` files.
- Keep pull requests small and single-purpose. Link the tracker key in the title.
- Use the [PR template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) for every pull request.
- Stop and ask for help when a requirement or permission is missing. Do not guess.
